title: LeetCode 295: Find Median from Data Stream
description: Simulate finding the running median after each number is inserted into a data stream. Given an integer array `stream`, return a list of medians after inserting each number in order.
constraints:
1 <= len(stream) <= 10^4
• Time: O(N log N) | Space: O(N)
explanation: Binary insertion into sorted stream allows computing current median after each addition in O(N log N) time.
